name: Lips
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding our speech, urging believers to set a watch over their lips to prevent harmful words (Psalms 141:3). Truthful and wise words are enduring and precious, likened to jewels, while lying lips are fleeting and destructive (Proverbs 12:19; 20:15). Gentle answers can defuse anger, contrasting with harsh words that provoke strife (Proverbs 15:1). Believers are called to avoid corrupt communication, instead speaking what builds up and ministers grace to others (Ephesians 4:29), highlighting the power of our lips to either harm or edify.
